summary:
  [Ref2VA] At night beside a narrow mountain stream, the python wife drinks the last of the wine her husband left behind; the liquor takes sudden hold and her body unfolds into a giant python whose intake drags the masked farmer and the cattle and sheep off their feet and into its mouth. One continuous low-angle medium shot follows the wine to the lips, the scales to the throat, and the final empty swallow without a cut.
  <Picture 1> = 婚房洞房夜 (scene): locked environment reference for spatial layout and set dressing.

retention_analysis:
  <Picture 1> (shots): fully_preserved
  Fixed: the referenced space and its set dressing stay constant through the shot. Follows the action: the low moonlight and wet-stone reflections, the drifting mist, the camera push and lateral drift, and every character and animal movement.

detailed_description:
  Photoreal cinematic night exterior, cool blue moonlight raking across wet stone and black water, shallow focus keeping the hands and throat crisp while the far bank falls away, the skin-to-scale change rendered with physical texture rather than graphic stylization.
  [Shot 1] 00.00–07.00s — 50mm medium shot, 9:16 vertical, low camera tilted slightly up, one uninterrupted stabilizer take. The python wife holds right of center facing screen left, right hand tilting a small earthenware wine vessel to her lower lip and left hand gathering the cloth at her chest; the masked farmer stands left rear, half turned toward her, both feet braced on the slick rock and fingers pinched into his tunic seam; cattle and sheep crowd the far left background, heads lifted toward her, hooves sliding on the wet ground. Narrow stream water crosses the foreground, rock walls close in on both sides, a cold blue key from above catches the spray while weak bounce from the water lifts her jaw and hands.
  00.00–02.20s: she tips the last of the wine into her mouth, two successive swallows travel down her throat, her brows draw tight and the outer corners of her eyes twitch; the vessel lowers to her sternum still held in her right hand, her lower lip stays wet, her left hand slides from her collar to her waist and the fingers curl in. The farmer shifts one foot back on the stone, his visible eyes widen, his hands clamp the tunic seam. The cattle and sheep turn their ears toward her and press shoulder to shoulder. Camera glides about 0.3 m closer, focus locked on lips, hand and throat.
  02.20–04.60s: her swallow stalls for half a beat, the cords of her neck rise and fall quickly, fine scale patterns push across her eye corners and the sides of her neck, her pupils contract then widen, her lips press into a thin line, the fingers of her right hand straighten one joint at a time around the vessel, her shoulders collapse forward and lift again, her breathing turns short and shallow. The farmer's upper body recoils, his hands rise to his chest and freeze, his heels score short marks in the wet stone; the animals lower their heads and jostle, hooves skidding. Camera tracks laterally about half a body width along her eyeline, holding her on the right and the farmer and livestock on the left.
  04.60–06.50s: her spine arches, the outline of her shoulders and neck swells out of the clothing into a giant serpent's body, her right hand keeps its grip on the vessel as scales travel up the forearm, a serpent neck rises behind her and the head thrusts forward to center-right, turning screen left and opening its jaws. The inflow becomes visible: mist, her hem, the animals' hair and the farmer's trouser cuffs all streak toward the mouth. The farmer is dragged from left rear to center, feet scraping short grooves, torso pitching forward while both arms claw backward at the ground; the cattle and sheep are drawn across left mid-frame in sequence, hooves kicking, and vanish into the shadow inside the jaws. Camera eases back with the suction and tilts up slightly to keep the head, the farmer's path and the livestock in one frame.
  06.50–07.00s: the serpent head settles center-right facing left, jaws half open, one slow swallow completes in the throat, the chest and belly keep rising and falling, the heavy eyelid drops and lifts once, rings spread across the water. Camera holds its position while the water and breathing continue. The whole take is non-verbal: stream water, cloth friction, two swallows, heavier breath, heel scrape, short animal bleats, the drawn inward rush of air, skidding hooves, the low dense thud of the swallow and its fading after-echo.

overall_soundscape:
  A shallow mountain stream runs continuously beneath the shot; wet cloth and leather creak with each shift of weight; two close swallows land at the lips; breath turns audible and ragged; heels grind on slick stone; cattle and sheep bleat and scramble; a rising inward rush of air pulls the ambience toward the serpent's mouth; hooves skid; a low, dense swallowing impact closes the intake; ripples and a slow low echo settle over the water in the last half-second.
